Rough storyboard sketch. Scene 12 — 5s
INT. EMPTY STAGE, AFTER — NIGHT
Overhead flat-lay on the scuffed black stage floor, single work light: the coral tube lying beside the crumpled napkin set list and a sweating water bottle. Her hand reaches in, drags the tube toward her, closes around it, and lifts it out of frame.. Loose pencil line drawing on white paper, quick gestural strokes, minimal detail. Simple placeholder figures with blank featureless faces, basic shapes for the setting, flat grey marker shading. Monochrome, no colour, no rendering, no realism, no photographic detail.
